description.what_this_is: One row per run, merged from the per-run metrics.json files in experiments/runs/. Values are copied verbatim from those files; nothing is recomputed here.
reading_notes: `ari`, `nmi`, `rare_f1`, `n_clusters`, `ari_vs_pseudo` come from the `scformer` block: the model's own output.

`ari_initial_partition` and `rare_f1_initial_partition` describe the partition a run started from, before training. This is the reference a dynamic-clustering run must beat to show it preserved its own starting structure. The `initial_partition_source` field on each row says where the value came from, because it is not the same source in every run: either the warm-up cluster partition (`dynamic.initial_partition`) or the A0 pseudo-label (recorded under `leiden_baseline` for runs whose `init_source` is `a0_pseudo`). Rows with neither are stage 0/1 runs, which have no such start.

`ari_leiden_reference` and `rare_f1_leiden_reference` come from the `leiden_baseline` block: the upstream Leiden partition. It answers a different question (did the model beat the free baseline) and must not be read as a run's starting partition; on the same run the two differ, 0.3298 vs 0.0813.

`ari_vs_pseudo` is agreement with the training pseudo-label, not with truth. A value near 1.0 means the model reproduced its target; see experiments/reports/fixed_target_headroom.json. It is absent for stage 0, which has no such target.
`spatial_relation` is whether the spot-to-spot spatial relation was enabled. The source files record this under two different key names depending on stage; they are merged here.

`pseudo_resolution` is the Leiden resolution that produced the training target. 0.5 yields no cluster below the 4.5% rarity threshold, so rare_f1 is pinned at 0 there; 0.8 does yield one, so rare_f1 is non-zero before any model runs.
Runs whose name contains `preflight`, `probe` or `warmuponly` are historical exploration, not the formal arms. `T30` runs use a 30-epoch refresh interval where the default is 10.

frozen_target_headroom.what: the baseline arm deviates from its pseudo-label on 0/1/65 spots across seeds

spatial_relation_on_aligned_basis.what: B0 - A* paired differences: ARI -0.118, NMI -0.141, boundary-F1 -0.040

construction_proof.what: max attainable rare-domain F1 over 42,525 5-way merges is 1.0000

partition_frontier.what: rare-domain F1 and ARI across Leiden resolutions

marker_screen.what: per-domain Wilcoxon statistics. Two domains clear all three criteria (follicle, hilum); only follicle's marker is spatially specific, since hilum's COL1A2 is high across the whole capsule and does not localize the domain

spatial_holdout.what: Three-seed training-time spatial holdout with full-graph inference; whole-section and held-out-region metrics

d1_cross_section.what: Independent CPU recount of 18 frozen-protocol runs on a second lymph-node section from the same study

null_layout_retraining.what: Independent CPU recount of retrained permuted-layout controls across A1 and D1

external_graphst_a1.what: Three-seed A1 GraphST comparison with saved predictions and independent CPU recount

external_graphst_cross_section.what: Three-seed GraphST comparisons on D1 and a breast section with saved predictions, post-prediction label joins, and per-run evaluations
